provenance: Eight self-authored legal move sequences fixed before the LMR candidate was built or searched. Common opening structures, without copying games or engine/book moves. No result or score was used for selection.
selection_policy: Use all eight starts, four White-to-move and four Black-to-move, both engine colors, 200 ms/move, max 300 plies. Initial exploratory sample only, not a representative or Elo estimate. Do not tune LMR thresholds to these outcomes. A ply-capped game remains unfinished.
